source_row.rationale: A patient bill of rights generally includes core elements such as the right to be treated with respect and dignity, the right to receive clear information about their condition and treatment options, the right to participate in decisions about their own care (including the right to refuse treatment), and the right to privacy and confidentiality of their health information, among other protections.
source_row.source_name: American Hospital Association — Patient Care Partnership / Patient Rights Standards
